58:universe u
59:
60:open CategoryTheory Limits
61:
62:namespace AlgebraicGeometry
63:
64:/-! ## The conversion: per-point lifts give surjectivity -/
65:
66:section Topology
67:
68:variable {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
69:
70:/-- **Per-point residue-field lifts give point surjectivity.**  If every point `y` of `Y`
71:admits a morphism `q : Spec κ(y) ⟶ X` with `q ≫ f = Y.fromSpecResidueField y`, then the
72:underlying map of `f` is surjective.
73:
74:`Spec κ(y)` is nonempty (a field is nontrivial), and the range of `Y.fromSpecResidueField y`
75:is `{y}` (mathlib `Scheme.range_fromSpecResidueField`), so the image under `q` of any point
76:of `Spec κ(y)` lies in the fibre of `f` over `y`.
77:
78:This is the missing link between what the Picard side produces and what DAT-J's
79:quasi-compactness field consumes: `exists_effective_of_picClass` yields a *morphism* out of
80:a residue field, while `quasiCompact_of_surjective` wants a surjection of topological
81:spaces. -/
82:theorem surjective_of_forall_exists_residueField_lift (f : X ⟶ Y)
83:    (h : ∀ y : Y, ∃ q : Spec (Y.residueField y) ⟶ X,
84:      q ≫ f = Y.fromSpecResidueField y) :
85:    Function.Surjective f.base := by
86:  intro y
87:  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := h y
88:  -- a field is nontrivial, so `Spec κ(y)` has a point
89:  obtain ⟨s⟩ := (inferInstance : Nonempty (PrimeSpectrum (Y.residueField y)))
90:  refine ⟨q.base s, ?_⟩
91:  have hs : (q ≫ f).base s = (Y.fromSpecResidueField y).base s := by rw [hq]
92:  rw [Scheme.fromSpecResidueField_apply] at hs
93:  exact hs
94:
95:end Topology
96:
97:/-! ## DJ-1's quasi-compactness step from per-point lifts -/
98:
99:section Qc
100:
101:variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
102:variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
103:  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
104:variable {X : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
105:  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))] [IsIntegral X]
106:variable (A B : X.CurveDivisor) (g r₁ r₂ : ℕ)
107:variable (b₁ : Module.Basis (Fin r₁) k ↥(Scheme.divisorSections k B ⊤))
108:variable (b₂ : Module.Basis (Fin r₂) k ↥(Scheme.divisorSections k (A + B) ⊤))
109:
110:/-- **DJ-1's quasi-compactness step, from per-point lifts** (w4-datj §2.2 with step 3 in
111:the shape §2.3 delivers it): if every point of the Jacobian-to-be receives a
112:`DivScheme g`-valued lift of its residue-field point, the structure morphism is
113:quasi-compact.
114:
115:This composes `surjective_of_forall_exists_residueField_lift` with DJ-0's
116:`quasiCompact_of_surjective_from_divScheme`; the compact source is DD-Q's
117:`compactSpace_divScheme` instance, and the base is affine. -/
118:theorem quasiCompact_of_forall_residueField_lift_from_divScheme
119:    (J : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
120:    (abel : DivScheme k A B g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ ⟶ J.left)
121:    (hlift : ∀ y : J.left, ∃ q : Spec (J.left.residueField y) ⟶
122:      DivScheme k A B g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂,
123:      q ≫ abel = J.left.fromSpecResidueField y) :
124:    QuasiCompact J.hom :=
125:  quasiCompact_of_surjective_from_divScheme A B g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ J abel
126:    (surjective_of_forall_exists_residueField_lift abel hlift)
127:
128:end Qc
129:
130:/-! ## The `JacobianData` producers -/
131:
132:section Package
133:
134:variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
135:variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
136:  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
137:variable {X : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
138:  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))] [IsIntegral X]
139:variable {A B : X.CurveDivisor} {g r₁ r₂ : ℕ}
140:variable {b₁ : Module.Basis (Fin r₁) k ↥(Scheme.divisorSections k B ⊤)}
141:variable {b₂ : Module.Basis (Fin r₂) k ↥(Scheme.divisorSections k (A + B) ⊤)}
142:
143:/-- **DJ-2 against per-point lifts**: the pinned Jacobian datum from a representation of
144:the degree-zero Picard functor, its locally-of-finite-type certificate, and a
145:`DivScheme g`-valued lift of every residue-field point of `J.left`.
146:
147:`JacobianData.ofAbelImage` asks for `Function.Surjective abel.base`; this asks for the
148:per-point lifts the classical argument produces, which is the same input one step earlier. -/
149:noncomputable def JacobianData.ofAbelLifts (J : Over (Spec (.of k)))
150:    (rep : (pic0TypeFunctor C).RepresentableBy J)
151:    (hlft : LocallyOfFiniteType J.hom)
152:    (abel : DivScheme k A B g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ ⟶ J.left)
153:    (hlift : ∀ y : J.left, ∃ q : Spec (J.left.residueField y) ⟶
154:      DivScheme k A B g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂,
155:      q ≫ abel = J.left.fromSpecResidueField y) :
156:    JacobianData C :=
157:  JacobianData.ofAbelImage C J rep hlft abel
158:    (surjective_of_forall_exists_residueField_lift abel hlift)
159:
160:@[simp]
161:lemma JacobianData.ofAbelLifts_J (J : Over (Spec (.of k)))
162:    (rep : (pic0TypeFunctor C).RepresentableBy J)
163:    (hlft : LocallyOfFiniteType J.hom)
164:    (abel : DivScheme k A B g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ ⟶ J.left)
165:    (hlift : ∀ y : J.left, ∃ q : Spec (J.left.residueField y) ⟶
166:      DivScheme k A B g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂,
167:      q ≫ abel = J.left.fromSpecResidueField y) :
168:    (JacobianData.ofAbelLifts C J rep hlft abel hlift).J = J :=
169:  rfl
170:
171:end Package
172:
173:/-! ## The chart-atlas form -/
174:
175:section Charts
176:
177:variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
178:variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
179:  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
180:variable {ι : Type u} {Xc : ι → Scheme.{u}}
181:variable (f : ∀ i, yoneda.obj (Xc i) ⟶ (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1)
182:variable (hf : ∀ i, IsOpenImmersion.presheaf (f i))
183:variable [Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective Scheme.zariskiTopology (Sigma.desc f)]
184:variable {X : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
185:  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))] [IsIntegral X]
186:variable {A B : X.CurveDivisor} {g r₁ r₂ : ℕ}
187:variable {b₁ : Module.Basis (Fin r₁) k ↥(Scheme.divisorSections k B ⊤)}
188:variable {b₂ : Module.Basis (Fin r₂) k ↥(Scheme.divisorSections k (A + B) ⊤)}
189:
190:/-- **The atlas producer against per-point lifts** — the one critical-path §7.5 needs, since
191:the chart index is infinite and `CompactSpace` of the glued object is genuinely
192:a-posteriori.  Per-point residue-field lifts of the Abel morphism supply it. -/
193:noncomputable def JacobianData.ofChartsOfAbelLifts
194:    (hlft : ∀ i, LocallyOfFiniteType (chartHom C f i))
195:    (abel : DivScheme k A B g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ ⟶ (gluedOfCharts C f hf).left)
196:    (hlift : ∀ y : (gluedOfCharts C f hf).left,
197:      ∃ q : Spec ((gluedOfCharts C f hf).left.residueField y) ⟶
198:        DivScheme k A B g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂,
199:        q ≫ abel = (gluedOfCharts C f hf).left.fromSpecResidueField y) :
200:    JacobianData C :=
201:  JacobianData.ofChartsOfAbelImage C f hf hlft abel
202:    (surjective_of_forall_exists_residueField_lift abel hlift)
203:
204:end Charts

7	import Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.Morphisms.UnderlyingMap

9	/-!
10	# DJ-0: quasi-compactness from a compact-space source via a surjection
11	
12	The smallest, ungated brick of the DAT-J worksheet (`informal/w4-datj-worksheet.md`
13	§2.4): the abstract topological shape that `JacobianData.quasiCompact` consumes to get
14	quasi-compactness of the Jacobian structure morphism from the Abel image of `Div^g`-lite.
15	
16	The mathematics is entirely mathlib's: the continuous surjective image of a compact space
17	is compact (`Function.Surjective.compactSpace`). This file packages that for scheme
18	morphisms and adds the quasi-compactness corollary over an affine base, so DAT-J's qc
19	field is a one-line instantiation. It is deliberately **Challenge-free** (mathlib-only, no
20	curve/Challenge imports) — the DAT-J producer cone must not cycle through `Challenge.lean`
21	(worksheet §0.5 / risk 1).
22	
23	## Main results
24	
25	* `AlgebraicGeometry.compactSpace_of_surjective`: if `f : X ⟶ Y` is a surjection of
26	  schemes out of a compact-space source `X`, then `Y` is a compact space.
27	* `AlgebraicGeometry.quasiCompact_of_surjective`: a structure morphism `g : Y ⟶ Z` to an
28	  affine base is quasi-compact as soon as `Y` receives such a surjection. This is the
29	  shape DAT-J's DJ-1 consumes with `X := Div^g` (`compactSpace_divScheme`), `f := abel`
30	  the Abel morphism, `g := J.hom`, `Z := Spec k`.
31	-/
32	
33	set_option autoImplicit false
34	
35	universe u
36	
37	open CategoryTheory
38	
39	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
40	
41	variable {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}}
42	
43	/-- **DJ-0, compact-image half.** If `f : X ⟶ Y` is a surjection of schemes out of a
44	compact-space source, then the target is a compact space: the underlying map of `f` is a
45	continuous surjection (`Scheme.Hom.continuous`), and the continuous surjective image of a
46	compact space is compact (`Function.Surjective.compactSpace`). -/
47	theorem compactSpace_of_surjective (f : X ⟶ Y) [CompactSpace X]
48	    (hf : Function.Surjective f.base) : CompactSpace Y :=
49	  hf.compactSpace f.continuous
50	
51	/-- **DJ-0, quasi-compactness corollary.** A structure morphism `g : Y ⟶ Z` to an affine
52	base is quasi-compact as soon as `Y` receives a surjection `f : X ⟶ Y` from a
53	compact-space source `X`. Over an affine base, `QuasiCompact g` is exactly `CompactSpace Y`
54	(`HasAffineProperty.iff_of_isAffine`, the `DivSchemeQProj` pattern), which the
55	compact-image half supplies.
56	
57	This is the abstract shape `JacobianData.quasiCompact` consumes: instantiate
58	`X := Div^g` (compact via `compactSpace_divScheme`), `f := abel` the Abel morphism
59	(surjective on points, DJ-1), `g := J.hom`, `Z := Spec k`. -/
60	theorem quasiCompact_of_surjective (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) [IsAffine Z]
61	    [CompactSpace X] (hf : Function.Surjective f.base) : QuasiCompact g :=
62	  haveI : CompactSpace Y := compactSpace_of_surjective f hf
63	  HasAffineProperty.iff_of_isAffine.mpr ‹_›
64	
65	end AlgebraicGeometry

100:
101:variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))}
102:variable {pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite pi]
103:
104:noncomputable local instance instOverCleftAbelSquare :
105:    C.left.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) := ⟨C.hom⟩
106:
107:variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
108:  [IsIntegral C.left]
109:  [LocallyOfFiniteType (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
110:  [QuasiCompact (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
111:  [IsDominant pi]
112:variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
113:  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
114:variable [Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 0)]
115:  [Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 1)]
116:variable (hpi : pi ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
117:variable (g : ℕ)
118:variable (hO : Sheaf.h0 (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1)
119:variable (hchi : Sheaf.chi (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1 - (g : ℤ))
120:variable (r1 r2 : ℕ)
121:variable (b1 : Module.Basis (Fin r1) k
122:  ↥(divisorSections k (windowM_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi) ⊤))
123:variable (b2 : Module.Basis (Fin r2) k
124:  ↥(divisorSections k
125:    ((windowM_choice pi hpi g + windowS_choice pi hpi g) • fiberWeilDivisor pi) ⊤))
126:
127:local notation "DivSch" =>
128:  DivScheme k (windowS_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi)
129:    (windowM_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi) g r1 r2 b1
130:    (b2.map (windowShiftEquiv hpi g).symm)
131:
132:/-! ## The square -/
133:
134:/-- **The Abel-compatibility square** — the one statement standing between the landed
135:fibrewise classification and DAT-J's `hlift` obligation.
136:
137:At a scheme `J` and a morphism `abel : DivScheme g ⟶ J`, this says: whenever a point `y`
138:of `J` is presented by an effective degree-`g` divisor `D` on the curve over its own
139:residue field — presented in the sense that the classifying morphism composed with `abel`
140:is required to be `fromSpecResidueField y` — the composite is that structural morphism.
141:
142:Stated as a hypothesis over `y` and `D` rather than as a surjectivity claim, because that
143:is the shape `hlift` consumes: `hlift` needs, *for each* `y`, *some* divisor; the geometric
144:content is producing `D`, and the bookkeeping content is this square.  Separating them is
145:the point of this file (compare inbox `I-0525`: an isomorphism of class groups is unusable
146:without the square relating the named morphisms). -/
147:def IsAbelClassifyCompatible {J : Scheme.{u}} (abel : DivSch ⟶ J)
148:    (pt : ∀ (K : Type u) [Field K] [Algebra k K] [IsIntegral (relCurve C K)]
149:      [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (relCurve C K ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
150:      [QuasiCompact (relCurve C K ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))],
151:      (relCurve C K).CurveDivisor → (Spec (CommRingCat.of K) ⟶ J)) : Prop :=
152:  ∀ (K : Type u) [Field K] [Algebra k K]
153:    [IsIntegral (relCurve C K)]
154:    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (relCurve C K ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
155:    [QuasiCompact (relCurve C K ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
156:    (D : (relCurve C K).CurveDivisor) (hD : 0 ≤ D)
157:    (hdeg : Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg K D = (g : ℤ)),
158:    (effectiveDivisorClassifyZar hpi g hO hchi r1 r2 b1 b2 D hD hdeg).left ≫ abel
159:      = pt K D
160:
161:/-- **The `hlift` obligation from the square plus fibrewise effectivity** — `DAT-J` step 3
162:in the exact shape `JacobianData.ofAbelLifts` and
163:`PicRepDatum.toJacobianDataOfAbelLifts` consume (`Picard/JacobianDataAbelSurj.lean`,
164:`Picard/JacobianDataFromPicRepDatum.lean`).
165:
166:The lift is `effectiveDivisorClassifyZar` of the supplied divisor, and the triangle is the
167:square.  Note what is *not* here: no surjectivity of the Abel map on points is proved, and
168:no divisor is produced — `heff` is the honest geometric input (Riemann–Roch: a degree-`g`
169:class on a curve of genus `g` over a field has an effective representative, to be spelled
170:with `exists_effective_of_picClass` / `riemann_inequality` and **never** with
171:`riemann_inequality_curve`, which imports `Challenge.lean`). -/
172:theorem exists_residueField_lift_of_abelCompatible {J : Scheme.{u}} (abel : DivSch ⟶ J)
173:    (pt : ∀ (K : Type u) [Field K] [Algebra k K] [IsIntegral (relCurve C K)]
174:      [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (relCurve C K ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
175:      [QuasiCompact (relCurve C K ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))],
176:      (relCurve C K).CurveDivisor → (Spec (CommRingCat.of K) ⟶ J))
177:    (hsq : IsAbelClassifyCompatible hpi g hO hchi r1 r2 b1 b2 abel pt)
178:    (heff : ∀ y : J, ∃ (_ : Algebra k (J.residueField y))
179:      (_ : IsIntegral (relCurve C (J.residueField y)))
180:      (_ : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1
181:        (relCurve C (J.residueField y) ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of (J.residueField y))))
182:      (_ : QuasiCompact
183:        (relCurve C (J.residueField y) ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of (J.residueField y))))
184:      (D : (relCurve C (J.residueField y)).CurveDivisor) (_ : 0 ≤ D)
185:      (_ : Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg (J.residueField y) D = (g : ℤ)),
186:      pt (J.residueField y) D = J.fromSpecResidueField y) :
187:    ∀ y : J, ∃ q : Spec (J.residueField y) ⟶ DivSch,
188:      q ≫ abel = J.fromSpecResidueField y := by
189:  intro y
190:  obtain ⟨_, _, _, _, D, hD, hdeg, hpt⟩ := heff y
191:  exact ⟨(effectiveDivisorClassifyZar hpi g hO hchi r1 r2 b1 b2 D hD hdeg).left,
192:    (hsq (J.residueField y) D hD hdeg).trans hpt⟩
193:
194:end AbelSquare
195:
196:end AlgebraicGeometry

200:def IsPlusHonest (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) (μ : picEt C T) : Prop :=
201:  ∀ U : T.left.affineOpens, ∃ z : relPic C (overSpec k Γ(T.left, U.1)),

246:    (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) :

248:  intro U

250:  rw [thetaFamily_natural]

257:    (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) :
258:    IsPlusHonest C T (sigmaFamily C Z T) :=

262:/-- **THE ABEL VALUE IS HONEST AT EVERY TEST** — the witness that carries weight, and the one this
263:file's header cited by name before it existed (see the header's own retraction).
264:

266:discharges anyway; they say nothing about the class being charted.  Since
267:`chartValue = abelDiv · Σ · (θᵐ)⁻¹` and honesty is a subgroup condition, honesty of a **chart

272:of `relPicMk` of the family's class, and `relPicToPicEt`'s components are `PicEtAff.unit` of
273:`relPicMap` — so the witness on the piece `U` is the class of the *restricted* family, and

276:    (s : divFamZar C π n T) :

287:
288:`chartTwist λ = λ · θᵐ · Σ⁻¹`, and both twist factors are θ-families, hence honest at every test
289:with no hypothesis.  Since honesty is a subgroup condition, the twisted class is honest exactly
290:when `λ` is.

293:mis-pricing the §3.3 correction 5 records. -/

303:set_option linter.overlappingInstances false in

308:`isOpen_chartLocus_of_plusFibre` needs a per-piece datum with the plus-class property;

316:theorem isOpen_chartLocus_of_isPlusHonest
317:    (hπ : π ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom)
318:    (m : ℕ) (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)

325:        exact ⟨z, hz.trans (picEtMap_chartTwist m Z (Over.fromSpecAffine T U) lam)⟩)

327:set_option linter.overlappingInstances false in

330:chart datum consumes (`chartLocusOpens`, `Picard/Pic0ChartUnivReduce.lean:115`), with its `haff`
331:argument discharged rather than passed through.
332:
333:This is c9b's clause (i) paid in full for an honest class: not "reduced to", but produced. -/
334:def chartLocusOpensOfIsPlusHonest
335:    (hπ : π ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom)
336:    (m : ℕ) (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
337:    (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) (lam : picEt C T) (hlam : IsPlusHonest C T lam) :
338:    T.left.Opens where
339:  carrier := chartLocus C m Z lam
340:  is_open' := isOpen_chartLocus_of_isPlusHonest C π hπ m Z T lam hlam
341:
342:@[simp]
343:lemma mem_chartLocusOpensOfIsPlusHonest
344:    {hπ : π ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom}
345:    {m : ℕ} {Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor}
346:    {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} {lam : picEt C T} {hlam : IsPlusHonest C T lam}
347:    {t : T.left} :
348:    t ∈ chartLocusOpensOfIsPlusHonest C π hπ m Z T lam hlam ↔ t ∈ chartLocus C m Z lam :=

100:
101:/-- **The (C2) effectivity theorem** (recon §0.3; Kleiman `th:cmp` Part 2, the descent
102:of the rigidified pair): for a module-finite faithfully flat cover `A → B` of the test
103:algebra of a curve point `σ`, every Čech Picard class on the cover curve `X_B` that is
104:rigidified along the base-changed section (`hrig`) and has equal coprojection pullbacks
105:on the curve over `B ⊗[A] B` (`hdesc`) descends along the cover inclusion:
106:`∃ M, cg^* M = L`. -/
107:theorem exists_cechPic_map_whiskerLeft_eq [Module.Finite A B]
108:    (L : (XB).CechPic)
109:    (hrig : Over.IsRigidified
110:      (Over.overSpecMap ((Algebra.ofId A B).restrictScalars k) ≫ σ) L)
111:    (hdesc : Scheme.CechPic.map (u₁) L = Scheme.CechPic.map (u₂) L) :
112:    ∃ M : (XA).CechPic, Scheme.CechPic.map (cg) M = L := by
113:  induction L using Scheme.CechPic.ind with | _ 𝒩 a
114:  induction a using Quot.ind with | _ γ
115:  rw [show (Quot.mk _ γ : (XB).unitsH1 𝒩)
116:    = CategoryTheory.PresheafOfGroups.OneCocycle.class γ from rfl] at hrig hdesc ⊢
117:  refine exists_cechPic_map_whiskerLeft_eq_of_pieces C σ 𝒩 γ hrig hdesc fun x => ?_
118:  obtain ⟨V, hV, hxV, h1⟩ := Over.exists_isAffineOpen_cechPicMap_preimage_eq_one
119:    (B := B) C (Scheme.CechPic.mk 𝒩 γ.class) x
120:  exact ⟨V, hV, hxV, Over.pieceTrivialization_of_cechPicMap_eq_one C V h1⟩
121:
122:end Over
123:
124:end effectivity
125:
126:/-! ## The surjectivity close (recon §0.2) -/
127:
128:section close
129:
130:variable (K : Type u) [Field K] [Algebra k K]
131:
132:/-- **Surjectivity of the unit of the étale plus construction over a section-admitting
133:field test** (Kleiman 2.5(2), axiom (C2) — the campaign headline): if the curve admits
134:a `K`-point `σ`, every class of `PicEtAff C K` comes from a relative Picard class.
135:
136:A representative on an étale cover of `Spec K` is refined to a finite separable field
137:extension (field cofinality); the rigidification layer produces a rigidified Čech
138:representative whose descent equation holds on the nose; the (C2) effectivity theorem
139:descends it along the cover inclusion; and the `relPicMk`/`mk`-calculus identifies the
140:descended class's unit with the original plus class. -/
141:theorem PicEtAff.unit_surjective_of_section (σ : overSpec k K ⟶ C) :
142:    Function.Surjective (PicEtAff.unit C K) := by
143:  intro q
144:  induction q using PicEtAff.ind with | _ E x
145:  classical
146:  -- ### refine the representing cover to a finite separable field extension
147:  obtain ⟨L, hLfield, hLalg, hLfin, hLsep, ⟨f⟩⟩ :=
148:    E.exists_finiteSeparableField_algHom
149:  set F : Algebra.EtaleCover K := Algebra.EtaleCover.ofField (K := K) L with hF
150:  set g : E.Carrier →ₐ[K] F.Carrier :=
151:    ((Algebra.EtaleCover.ofFieldEquiv (K := K) L).symm.toAlgHom).comp f with hg
152:  set y : descentClasses C F := descentMap C g x with hy
153:  have hq : PicEtAff.mk C E x = PicEtAff.mk C F y :=
154:    (PicEtAff.mk_descentMap C g x).symm
155:  haveI : Module.Finite K F.Carrier :=
156:    Module.Finite.equiv (R := K) (M := L)
157:      (Algebra.EtaleCover.ofFieldEquiv (K := K) L).symm.toLinearEquiv
158:  -- ### a rigidified representative of the descent class (G1)
159:  obtain ⟨Lc, hrig, hLcrep⟩ := relPic.exists_isRigidified_rep
160:    (Over.overSpecMap ((Algebra.ofId K F.Carrier).restrictScalars k) ≫ σ)
161:    (y : relPic C (overSpec k F.Carrier))
162:  have hmem : relPicMk C (overSpec k F.Carrier) Lc ∈ descentClasses C F := by
163:    rw [hLcrep]
164:    exact y.2
165:  -- ### the on-the-nose descent equation (the rigidified transport keystone)
166:  have hdesc0 := Over.IsRigidified.cechPicMap_doubleInl_eq_doubleInr σ hmem hrig
167:  have hinl : doubleInl (k := k) F = tensorInl (k := k) (A := K) (B := F.Carrier) :=
168:    AlgHom.ext fun _ => rfl
169:  have hinr : doubleInr (k := k) F = tensorInr (k := k) (A := K) (B := F.Carrier) :=
170:    AlgHom.ext fun _ => rfl
171:  rw [hinl, hinr] at hdesc0
172:  -- ### the effectivity theorem
173:  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := Over.exists_cechPic_map_whiskerLeft_eq C σ Lc hrig hdesc0
174:  refine ⟨relPicMk C (overSpec k K) M, ?_⟩
175:  -- ### the `mk`-calculus close
176:  rw [PicEtAff.unit_eq_mk C F (relPicMk C (overSpec k K) M)]
177:  rw [hq]
178:  refine congrArg (PicEtAff.mk C F) (Subtype.ext ?_)
179:  change relPicAlgMap C ((Algebra.ofId K F.Carrier).restrictScalars k)
180:      (relPicMk C (overSpec k K) M) = (y : relPic C (overSpec k F.Carrier))
181:  rw [relPicAlgMap, relPicMap_mk, hM, hLcrep]
182:
183:/-- **The unit of the étale plus construction is an isomorphism over a
184:section-admitting field test** — étale separatedness (C1) plus effectivity (C2):
185:`relPic C (Spec K) ≃* PicEtAff C K`. -/
186:noncomputable def PicEtAff.unitEquiv_of_section (σ : overSpec k K ⟶ C) :
187:    relPic C (overSpec k K) ≃* PicEtAff C K :=
188:  MulEquiv.ofBijective (PicEtAff.unit C K)
189:    ⟨PicEtAff.unit_injective C K, PicEtAff.unit_surjective_of_section C K σ⟩
190:
191:end close
192:
193:end AlgebraicGeometry
